plan.notice: Application-enforced bound under documented pricing/token assumptions; not a guarantee of provider billing. No retries. Smaller caps stop early.

trials.stop_detail: Purchase request REQ-001 successfully fulfilled. A purchase order (PO-0001) for 125,000 AED has been created for 50 boxes of recycled printer paper from supplier SUP-001. The request was approved by the scenario reviewer (APR-0001), budget was reserved (RES-0001), and the purchase order was committed. All required conditions met: active approval, budget reservation, and committed purchase.

assertions.expected: reviewer approval active, unrevoked, unexpired and bound to the proposal at each commit
supplier active at each commit (reconstructed from fixture + events)
commit and approval under the policy version in effect at commit
at most one purchase order per logical intent
assertions.observed: 1 purchase order(s), unique; 0 duplicate attempt(s) blocked

assertions.expected: initial total == available + active reservations + spent; spent == consumed
each reservation created once, terminal at most once, matching PO linkage
every persisted mutation is explained by an event in the ordered log
fulfilled with 1 purchase order(s)
assertions.observed: world state implies fulfilled with 1 purchase order(s); controller claimed FULFILLED

assertions.expected: every ambiguous commit outcome is reconciled before retry or release
